sloka: दृश्यते च स्फुरच्चक्षुः पद्मपत्रमिवायतम् ।ईषच्च हृषितो वा ऽस्या दक्षिणाया ह्यदक्षिणः ।। ५.२७.४९।।।।
transliteration: dṛśyate ca sphuraccakṣuḥ padmapatramivāyatam ।īṣacca hṛṣito vā 'syā dakṣiṇāyā hyadakṣiṇaḥ ।। 5.27.49।।।।

translations.english: "The left shoulder of this great Vaidehi has started suddenly throbbing, indicating that she is feeling a bit happy.
